name: UI Motion, Swipes & Slides
when_to_use: Phone mockups swiping, scrolling a feed or site, UI panels animating in, cards or screenshots sliding onto the stage, app windows opening, dashboards building, cards orbiting the speaker.

sounds.name: Glitch Scroll Tick 01
sounds.desc: Tiny 30 ms bright digital noise tick; repeat it for scrolling a feed, hovering over items, or letter-by-letter type-on.

sounds.name: Glitch Scroll Tick 02
sounds.desc: Soft, airy bright noise tick about an eighth of a second long; use for gentle scroll steps or hover states in a screen recording.

sounds.name: Glitch Scroll Tick 03
sounds.desc: Mid-bright digital tick with a little body and a quick decay; use for scroll notches or menu hovers.

sounds.name: Glitch Scroll Tick 04
sounds.desc: Quiet, airy bright tick about 120 ms long; use under subtle scroll or hover moments where clicks would be too loud.

sounds.name: Glitch Scroll Tick 05
sounds.desc: Bright noise tick with a sharp hit and quick fade; use for scrolling a feed or typing on screen.

sounds.name: Soft Scroll Tick 01
sounds.desc: Clean tonal tick with a fast, smooth decay; use for list items, hover highlights or a polished scroll notch.

sounds.name: Soft Scroll Tick 02
sounds.desc: Short, soft and rounded tonal tick that dies away almost instantly; use for hover states, list items or quiet scroll notches.

sounds.name: Soft Scroll Tick 03
sounds.desc: Tiny tonal tick with a very fast decay; use as a clean scroll notch or letter-by-letter type-on tick.

sounds.name: Soft Scroll Tick 04
sounds.desc: Low-mid tonal tick, soft and quick; use for gentle hover or list highlights in an app demo.

sounds.name: Soft Scroll Tick 05
sounds.desc: Mono tonal tick with a slightly brighter tone and short decay; use for scroll wheel notches or menu item hovers.

sounds.name: Panel Close Swish 01
sounds.desc: A short bright airy zip that falls away; use when a popup, panel or card closes or snaps out of frame.

sounds.name: Panel Close Swish 02
sounds.desc: A 0.3 s bright zippy swish that decays out; use as a panel, menu or card closes or slides away.

sounds.name: Panel Open Swish 01
sounds.desc: A short bright airy zip that builds into its end; use as a popup, panel or menu opens.

sounds.name: Panel Open Swish 02
sounds.desc: A 0.3 s bright zip that rises into its end; use to back-time into a panel, card or window opening.

sounds.name: Sandy Swish 01
sounds.desc: Short grainy, sand-like bright swish of about 0.2 s; use when a small UI element appears or dissolves.
sounds.credit_line: "UI Clicky Sound and FX Pack" by Gmorkh (https://gmorkh.itch.io/uiscp), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Scroll Tick Run 01
sounds.desc: A mid-pitched tonal one-second scroll run; use it for scrolling a list or a code window in a screen recording.

sounds.name: Scroll Tick Run 02
sounds.desc: A crisp, clicky one-second scroll run that peaks mid-way; use it for flicking through a phone feed or a carousel.

sounds.name: Scroll Tick Run 03
sounds.desc: A one-second tonal scroll run with an even level; use it for scrolling a menu or a list of results.

sounds.name: UI Collapse Swish 01
sounds.desc: A bright airy 0.2 s falling swish; use as a card collapses or a popup dismisses.

sounds.name: UI Collapse Swish 02
sounds.desc: A half-second decaying swish; use as a window shrinks away or the shot pulls back to the speaker.

sounds.name: UI Expand Swell 01
sounds.desc: A bright airy 0.2 s rising swish; use as a card pops open or a UI element zooms up.

sounds.name: UI Expand Swell 02
sounds.desc: A bright 0.4 s rising hiss-swell; use as a panel or dashboard expands open.

sounds.name: Glitch Scroll Tick 06
sounds.desc: Loud, bright 50 ms digital crackle tick; use for fast feed scrolling or type-on letters in a tech edit.

sounds.name: Glitch Scroll Tick 07
sounds.desc: Quick bright noise tick with a sharp start; use for repeated scroll steps or digital type-on.

sounds.name: Glitch Scroll Tick 08
sounds.desc: Very bright, crisp 50 ms digital tick with a slightly tonal edge; use for scroll ticks or type-on letters.

sounds.name: Glitch Scroll Tick 09
sounds.desc: Bright 70 ms noise tick with a mild decay; use for scroll steps or hovering across items.

sounds.name: Glitch Scroll Tick 10
sounds.desc: Quiet bright noise tick with a soft 35 ms attack; use for smooth, subtle scroll or hover movement.

sounds.name: Glitch Scroll Tick 11
sounds.desc: Loud 60 ms burst of flat digital static with no real decay; use as a gritty scroll or type-on tick in glitch-styled edits.

sounds.name: Glitch Scroll Tick 12
sounds.desc: Ultra-short 25 ms bright static blip; stack it rapidly for fast scrolls or type-on.

sounds.name: Panel Close Swish 03
sounds.desc: A 0.3 s airy high zip falling away; use when a window, popup or overlay closes.

sounds.name: Panel Close Swish 04
sounds.desc: A very bright hissy zip that decays over 0.3 s; use as a card or panel dismisses out of frame.

sounds.name: Sandy Swish 02
sounds.desc: Processed sandy swish with a ~0.5 s tail and a hot peak; use for a panel or card materialising or dissolving away.
sounds.credit_line: "UI Clicky Sound and FX Pack" by Gmorkh (https://gmorkh.itch.io/uiscp), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Scroll Tick Run 04
sounds.desc: A dark, tonal one-second scroll sequence with low bloopy ticks; use it for slowly scrolling a website or dashboard.

sounds.name: UI Collapse Swish 03
sounds.desc: A short falling synth swish; use when a panel or card shrinks away or a window minimises.

sounds.name: UI Collapse Swish 04
sounds.desc: A bright 0.4 s hissy swish that falls away; use when a dashboard or panel folds closed.

sounds.name: UI Expand Swell 03
sounds.desc: A short rising synth swell that ends on its peak; use as a panel or card expands or scales up into frame.

sounds.name: UI Expand Swell 04
sounds.desc: A half-second building swell that ends on its peak; use to back-time into a window or card opening to full size.
